rules.title: GLFW failed to initialise
rules.advice: Usually a display-server issue. On Wayland install **libdecor-0** and enable the *Display Server Tweaks* plugin's `Force libdecor` toggle. On X11, make sure `DISPLAY` is set. Inside SSH/VNC, you may need to launch with `__GL_FORCE_GENERIC_CPU=1`.

rules.title: OpenGL is not available
rules.advice: Your GPU driver doesn't expose the OpenGL profile Minecraft needs. Update graphics drivers. On Linux, check that `glxinfo` reports a `direct rendering: Yes`. Inside flatpak make sure the **GL** runtime extension matches your driver (`flatpak install org.freedesktop.Platform.GL.default`).

rules.title: Shader pack causes crash
rules.advice: The active shader pack failed to compile against your driver. Try disabling shaders (in-game F3 + R), or remove the shader pack from `shaderpacks/`. Mesa users can sometimes fix it by switching to `MESA_GL_VERSION_OVERRIDE=4.6`.
